 ----------
 This writ petition is filed under Articles 226 &
227 of the Constitution of India with a prayer to quash the impugned seizure conducted by the respondent No.2, dated 30.05.2013 produced herewith as Annexures-N and P and quash the impugned notice issued by respondent No.4 dated 13.06.2013 is produced as per Annexure-Q.

This petition coming on for Preliminary Hearing this day, the court made the following:
 ORDER
Petitioner contends that it is a Society registered under the provisions of the Karnataka Societies Registration Act.
The petitioner-Society is engaged in supply of drinking water under the name and style of "Swati Aqua Processed Drinking Water" to its members.

The respondents under the impugned orders at Annexures-N and P seized the drinking water system of the petitioner-Society on the ground that the same is in violation of provisions of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
In furtherance of the same, proceedings are initiated before the respondent-Deputy Commissioner and he has issued a notice as per Annexure-Q dated 13.06.2013.
A perusal of Annexure- Q specifies that petitioners are called upon to appear before the respondent-Deputy Commissioner and to submit their explanation.

Keeping open all contentions urged by the petitioner in this writ petition, the same is hereby disposed of directing the petitioner to appear before the respondent-Deputy Commissioner and to contest the proceedings.

The respondent-Deputy Commissioner, in turn, to pass appropriate orders after hearing the petitioner, in accordance with law and as expeditiously as possible and, in any event, not later than six weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.

Sd/-
